_comment: Every food table the tools offer, all on an equal footing. build_index.py reads this, checks each table's files and writes data/foods/tables.json (this list with counts) and data/foods/index.json (every food's name, for Food Finder's list). Adding a table: build its two food files, add an entry here, rerun build_index.py. 'basic' is the Planner's list (foods it can suggest); 'more' is every other food in the table, for Food Finder. 'standards' are the target standards for which the table is the default.
